name: web-welcome-announcement-modal-with-emoji-value-tag-help-box-and-checkbox
title: Light modal 'Welcome Newcult.co Users' with an emoji title, a $299 value chip, a grey help box and a dark View templates button
whatItIs: A white rounded dialog on dark grey with an emoji and bold title, an x, sections 'For new users' and 'For existing users' with a small $299 Value chip, a grey inset help box with a question icon and a Get login assistance link, a 'Don't show again' checkbox and a dark View templates button with an external-link icon.
whatItMeans: Friendly and informative; sections, a value chip and a help box keep a long notice scannable.
techniques: Put help in a tinted inset.
End with a dismiss checkbox and one dark button.

vocabulary.definition: A small label stating a worth or price.
A tinted box with support information.
A checkbox to suppress a dialog.
A button with an outward arrow icon.
